acceptance: Snowflake and BigQuery runs of tpcds_obt resolve their local cache to the OBT output folder, not the TPC-DS source folder; both orchestrator paths share one helper that honours GENERATES_OWN_OUTPUT, with a regression test on the cloud-staging path
A run fails before the power test when any table in the benchmark's get_schema() is missing or has zero rows after load
The bundle validator reports an error when the benchmark's schema tables are absent from the bundle's tables section
Existing OBT, TPC-DS and data-sharing tests pass; PR opened through make pr-open
context: Implemented in PR #2505 (branch fix/tpcds-obt-cloud-staging-output, commits 46f72138a and aebfff59d), opened held (auto-merge not armed). Changes: orchestrator _local_datagen_name helper shared by both output-root paths; REQUIRED_LOADED_TABLES guard after load in the adapter and the runner's load-only path; manifest reuse rejects the source manifest for GENERATES_OWN_OUTPUT benchmarks; public TPCDSOBT wrapper mirrors both attributes; bundle validator errors when a tpcds_obt bundle lacks the OBT table, shows it empty, or has measured queries without a tables block. External codex review: 2 High + 1 Medium, all accepted and fixed (PR comment 5936812345). 4,874 tests pass; the wrong Snowflake bundle now fails validation while BigQuery, Databricks and the three committed OBT bundles pass. Follow-up outside this item: rerun Snowflake tpcds_obt SF1 once #2505 merges.
description: On Snowflake and BigQuery (platforms with a cloud default_output_location), tpcds_obt resolves its local cache to the TPC-DS source folder (datagen/tpcds_sf1). orchestrator._resolve_custom_output_root picks the cache from get_data_source_benchmark() and ignores GENERATES_OWN_OUTPUT; #2420 fixed the same redirect only on the construction path. When the TPC-DS manifest there is valid, the runner reuses it (the reuse gate accepts the data-source manifest), fills benchmark.tables with the 25 normalized TPC-DS tables, never calls OBT generate_data, and the loader never loads tpcds_sales_returns_obt. The DDL creates the OBT table empty, so all 89 queries run against an empty table and the run reports success (Snowflake bundle tpcds_obt_sf1_snowflake_sql_20261001_112551_a3b5cd41: Q2 returns 0 rows vs 52 on BigQuery/Databricks). Nothing checks before measurement that the benchmark's own schema tables are loaded with rows, and the bundle validator does not compare loaded tables with the benchmark schema.
